development_corrections: A Docker internal-only API network did not publish its requested localhost port. Added an ingress bridge only to the API; model/processor network stays internal.
An initial existing Python suite invocation lacked the model bind mount. Re-ran with checksum-verified local weights; all 18 passed.
Client document/search output originally parsed and re-encoded numbers. Changed CLI output to exact server bytes; arbitrary-precision decimal verified after restore.
limits: Single-user localhost API; no public authentication or complete slow-client connection deadline.
One interactive CPU lane and one background lane; overload fails for explicit retry. GPU active work is non-preemptive.
PDF conversion precedes durable upload acknowledgment; retained canonical artifact supports subsequent stage recovery.
Export requires API downtime; initial limits 8 GiB / 100000 files. No compaction or garbage collection.
Pinned base/model/Cargo/Python artifacts; Debian package repositories are not frozen snapshots.
Two smoke answers and a small corpus do not establish quality, throughput or memory peaks. T10 remains pending.
